name: HZ_CUST_ACCT_RELATE_ALL
description: The HZ_CUST_ACCT_RELATE_ALL table stores information about relationships between customer accounts. The CUSTOMER_RECIPROCAL_FLAG indicates whether a relationship is recirprocal or not.

columns.name: RELATED_CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
